We take child privacy seriously. All video streams, audio feeds, and location coordinates are encrypted with 256-bit AES end-to-end encryption. No third-party ad networks or data brokers ever have access to child device telemetry.

By using KidsLink Parental Control, you confirm you are the legal parent or guardian of the child whose device is being supervised. Monitoring devices without legal parental consent is strictly prohibited.

KidsLink complies strictly with the Children\'s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and GDPR for Kids. Parents retain absolute ownership and deletion rights over all gathered media and location logs.
